name: Mesoké : An inside journey
detailed_description:
A journey within, between sky and memory

You play as Mesoké, a meditating woman.
Her spirit drifts through a floating inner universe filled with forgotten landscapes, emotional fragments, and traces of self.

Carried by the fabric of a kite, you'll discover dreamlike worlds, each with its own unique atmosphere.
Find your rhythm, soar high or skim close to the abyss, and slowly piece together this sensitive world.

Flight, finesse, risk and expression

  • A fluid, intuitive, sensory flying experience designed to evoke lightness, gliding, and breath.

  • A risk/reward system: the closer you fly to danger, the more vital energy (Chi) you gather.

  • A momentum mechanic lets you stay aloft with grace — the more precise your flight, the more the world carries you.

A sanctuary that evolves with you

  • A living central HUB (Mesoké’s inner palace) that grows with your discoveries.

  • Each world is a sensory reflection of an emotion: joy, loss, stillness, forgetfulness…

  • A wordless narrative, conveyed through space, sound, light, and silence.

An experience at the crossroads of genres

  • Poetic flying game

  • Contemplative inner exploration

  • Wordless spatial puzzle based on memory and sensation

Mesoké is for those who want to...

  • Let themselves be carried

  • Explore without a map

  • Feel without explanation

  • Heal and savor without needing to understand

short_description: Mesoké is a poetic and introspective flying game. Glide freely through an ever-shifting inner world, where every movement brushes against memory, emotion, and beauty. Explore, take risks, and collect the vital energy that brings your inner sanctuary back to life — and perhaps, yourself too.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Quad-Core (i5 2300) or AMD Octo-Core (FX 8150)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 660Ti or higher, AMD Radeon HD 7950 or higher (minimum 2 GB dedicated VRAM GDDR5)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
